cameras.pushHint: Push camera: a remote publisher (ffmpeg, OBS) pushes a stream INTO the NVR. The camera appears offline until a publisher connects. Ensure the SRT (UDP 9000) or RTMP (TCP 1935) port is reachable from the publisher's network (port-forward if behind NAT).
cameras.pushOutHint:
Forward ("push") this camera's live stream to an external platform — e.g. Bilibili/Douyin/YouTube live, another NVR, or a backup server. Each target is one independent connection.

[How to fill the URL] The URL field is the FULL destination address the platform gave you; the RTMP/RTSP selector must match the address prefix:
• RTMP (common for live platforms): address looks like rtmp://server/app/stream-key — note your stream key is the LAST path segment, e.g. rtmp://live-push.bilivideo.com/live-bvc/?streamkey=YOUR_KEY.
• RTSP: address looks like rtsp://server/path.

Once filled, the full push address is shown live below for you to copy and verify. After saving you can also copy it from the camera card's "1/1" badge. H.265 cameras are auto-transcoded to H.264 before pushing.

cameras.audioInRecordingsHint: Default off: recordings are video-only (live preview and the audio trigger are unaffected)
cameras.ambientArchiveHint: Saves the raw G.711 ambience as a sidecar file for post-production
cameras.subStreamHint: A lower-resolution secondary feed for grid preview, GB28181 cascade and external AI push (does not affect main-stream recording). ONVIF cameras auto-discover the sub profile after connecting; RTSP cameras can use a manual sub URL.
cameras.subProfileTokenHint: Picks the highest-resolution profile below the main one; set manually to override, clear and save to re-discover.
